question: Daler Mehndi is primarily a famous singer of pop songs in which Indian language?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Punjabi**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Daler Mehndi** is widely recognized for his contributions to Punjabi pop music.
 
• He gained immense popularity with his energetic songs and vibrant music videos that often feature traditional Punjabi themes and dance.
 
• Some of his most famous tracks include "Bolo Ta Ra Ra," "Tunak Tunak Tun," and "Ho Jayegi Ball
